energy jumps at collision step violating energy_bound
body 0 speed decreases but system energy increases due to body 1 speed jump

counterfactual.change: Changed restitution e from 1.0 to 0.9 on both bodies; inelastic collision no longer creates energy, confirming bug is specific to e=1 elastic collision handling (positional correction adding energy)

explanation: Elastic collision between two circles with e=1 creates energy. Just before contact (step 155) energy equals initial 1998.4 J, with bodies barely separated (gap 0.017). At step 156 collision resolves to 2261.85 J, exceeding allowed limit 2203.24 J despite zero gravity and disabled controller. Lowering restitution to 0.9 removes violation, indicating impulse/positional-correction code adds energy in the perfectly elastic case.
vision_note: Steps 153-155 show a large blue circle descending toward a small blue circle with the gap steadily closing to near-contact. At step 156 the two bodies are visibly overlapping/interpenetrating instead of cleanly rebounding, indicating a collision-resolution anomaly at the exact violation step.
